{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_final
# Based on the data dictionary, -999.0 is a sentinel for missing
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Count how many times the sentinel value appears
count_sentinel = (data['biomarker_final'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Replace sentinel values with NaN
data_clean = data.copy()
data_clean['biomarker_final'] = data_clean['biomarker_final'].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA)

# Check the count of missing values after replacement
missing_after = data_clean['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum()

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final after cleaning
total_mean = data_clean['biomarker_final'].mean(numeric_only=True)

# Print results
count_sentinel, missing_after, total_mean"}
